title: Locker Rental: waitlist terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, whether a waitlist is offered when that tier is fully booked at a club, and the maximum waitlist position offered before the waitlist closes.

## Waitlist table
| Tier | Waitlist offered | Maximum waitlist position offered |
|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | Yes | 5 |
| Medium Locker | Yes | 5 |
| Large Locker | Yes | 5 |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | Yes | 3 |
| Day-Use Locker | No | 0 (not applicable; no waitlist is offered for this tier) |
| VIP Locker Suite | Yes | 2 |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- Is a waitlist offered for the Day-Use Locker tier when it is fully booked at a club? No; this is the only tier for which no waitlist is offered.
- Which tier offers the shortest waitlist, and to what maximum position? The VIP Locker Suite, up to position 2.
- What is the maximum waitlist position offered for a Small Locker? Position 5.
